answer: Each agent anchors its identity to one distinct paid service subscription — one live API key the provider confirms is never shared. Three random peers check the provider-signed receipt each epoch and compare keys across the atlas of agents; two identities on one subscription are both frozen, rewards held three epochs. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 live subscriptions at $20 a month each, $20,000 a month, while one honest agent reuses the subscription it already pays for, free. The horizon of cheap fakes ends where real billing begins, and one shared ember betrays the whole cluster.
